slides.subtitle: The unreasonable effectiveness of single-file local-first software.
slides.notes: Welcome everyone. Introduce the thesis of durable single-file software.

slides.title: Why Single-File Matters
points: Zero cloud rent — you own the file forever
Instant offline execution in any modern browser
No SaaS logins, subscriptions, or dark patterns
slides.highlightDesc: A file saved in 2026 will open without servers in 2036.
slides.notes: Emphasize data sovereignty and local longevity.

slides.title: Adoption Velocity
slides.subtitle: Teams craft and share bespoke instruments in minutes rather than quarters.
slides.notes: Highlight rapid iteration cycles compared to bloated enterprise apps.

slides.quoteText: The interface should feel composed before it feels configurable. Start with a strong opinion, then leave the edges open for the owner.
